text:
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to primarily handle manual testing with strong knowledge of automation testing tools and techniques.
 Role & Responsibilities:

• Excellent manual testing skills.

• Hands-on experience in software development and agile methodologies.

• Collaborate with QA Analysts and Software Developers to develop solutions.

• Write clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans and test cases.

• Analyze and evaluate Software and Business Requirement Documents during all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle.

• Prepare Test Plans, Test Strategies, and Test Cases as per Business Requirements.

• Communicate and interpret critical business areas early in an application to prioritize test cases accordingly.

 Core/Must have skills:

• Manual testing experience

• Knowledge of Automated Functional, Integration, System, Regression, and Usability testing.

• Proficient in Designing and Developing Test Automation scripts.

• Experience with Automation tools such as Selenium, Cucumber.

• Strong functional testing knowledge.

• Good SQL knowledge.

• Database back-end testing expertise.

 Good to have skills:

• Framework knowledge of Automation.

• API testing experience.

• Testing experience in Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
